byte_preservation: All copied originals are byte-identical. Only permanent archive names receive .log suffixes; original receipts and patches are not rewritten. Each original receipt path resolves through archive_path_mapping.

v1.type_state: Genuine nonignored six-file baseline: 37 errors and 14 warnings; successor required.

v2.type_state: Genuine six-file check: zero errors and warnings; deliberate shared seams exposed through public aliases with legacy names retained.

v3.type_state: Final combined eight-file check after exact worker model/API freeze: zero errors and warnings.

invalid_initial_scope.meaning: Absolute include paths were ignored; the process was stopped. This report establishes no typed-source proof.

eight_file_intermediate.meaning: Worker-model typing was not yet frozen; this is an intermediate observation.

eight_file_final.scope_note: Eight new core/worker schema/model/API/helper files; not the full modified provider set. The inherited CI config emits an existing unrecognized reportUnnecessaryTypeIgnoreComments setting warning on stderr.

preserved_failures.meaning: Four dots are partial output only. The old process was defunct, the session no longer existed, and JUnit was absent. No pass/fail exit is inferred.
Four passes and one test failure: unsupported profile correctly returned the existing HTTP 422 while the new test incorrectly expected 409. Product behavior was retained.
Fourteen passes then a missing worker fixture. The test now creates its real worker through worker_heartbeat.
The test constructed an Event without required id and occurred. Valid construction allowed all scoped unsupported-backend controls to run.
Worker capability is liveness metadata; its WorkPool FK was corrected to cascade in ORM and both migrations. Physical assignment history retains its restrictive Worker FK.
The restrictive assignment FK exposed the special early WorkPool deletion. The fixture now removes graph hierarchy first, without weakening the product FK.

sqlite.selector: not child_http_scope and not csrf_enabled and not profile_admission_fails_closed and not public_partitioned_seal_requires_deployment and not public_admission_cannot_promote_internal_local_discovery_graph

provenance_limitations: Original receipts preserve their original temporary paths and timestamps; archive_path_mapping supplies portable relative references without changing bound bytes.
The v1 snapshot was captured during component execution; no retroactive atomic start is claimed. Later bundles state their own source and dependency boundaries.

Metadata API/model tests use controlled process identities and establish server protocol behavior. They do not establish real kernel death, real two-worker placement or complete native acceptance by themselves.
The v3 own 27-file set was stable, while an external worker-model type cast changed during the component replay. The final type report ran after exact worker hashes were frozen.
Full CI ignores many server directories. Only the documented nonignored actual-file scopes constitute the additional type proof here.
No claim of cross-host recovery, hostile tenant isolation, industrial throughput or completion of every ADR42-48 criterion follows from these component results.
